dataset_name: ISIC 2024 / Historical: The International Skin Imaging Collaboration skin lesion analysis challenges

metadata.summary: The ISIC Archive and its annual challenges provide the largest publicly available collection of dermoscopic images of skin lesions for skin cancer analysis. ISIC 2024 (SLICE-3D) released 401,059 training images (crops from 3D total-body photography) from 1,042 patients for melanoma classification. Historical challenges (e.g., 2020) contributed 33,126 DICOM images and incorporated prior datasets including HAM10000.
metadata.purpose: Skin cancer classification and segmentation for academic challenge participation.

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification performed per HIPAA Safe Harbor; removal of all protected health information and facial features.
ethics.legal_compliance: Compliant with GDPR and HIPAA de-identification standards where applicable.

known_limitations: Underrepresentation of rare skin lesion subtypes and non-Caucasian skin tones.
Geographic bias toward high-resource dermatology centers.
Temporal bias: older subsets (e.g., HAM10000) reflect earlier imaging protocols and annotation practices.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Predominantly light-skin-tone and Western-center derived; limited representation of Fitzpatrick skin types V–VI and low-resource settings.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Yes — melanoma, nevus, and basal cell carcinoma dominate; rarer classes (e.g., dermatofibroma, vascular lesions) are underrepresented.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Missing demographic metadata (age, sex, ethnicity) for majority of samples.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Commercial deployment without explicit permission; real-time clinical decision support without regulatory validation.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Images selected from international multi-site contributors for skin cancer analysis challenges.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Multi-site aggregation; images derived from 3D total-body photography (2024) and prior dermoscopic collections (e.g., HAM10000, 2020 challenge).

population.target_population: Patients with skin lesions undergoing dermoscopic or 3D total-body imaging.

annotation.labeling_provenance: Expert-labeled clinical ground truth; labels derived from histopathology or expert consensus diagnosis.
annotation.label_noise_description: Label noise exists due to inter-observer variability and diagnostic uncertainty in borderline cases.
